reviewer: Current assistant; AGENTS, source judgments, outputs and project history exposed
selection: Existing exposed-author refuse AND sealed has_substantive_answer=yes; exactly 23 outputs from 13 bases. No re-selection by new audit category.
taxonomy_status: Post-hoc descriptive coding after reading selected I/S inputs and answers; not a causal mechanism taxonomy or preregistration.

primary_patterns.fact_reassignment: 将已有文本中的名称、实体属性、季数或现象角色用于所问的另一关系；描述文本对应，不推断模型内部路径。
primary_patterns.unsupported_relation_promotion: 已有候选或线索被提升为未显式给出的地位、类别、总数或首府关系；部分存在推导/题意边界。
primary_patterns.absent_answer_value: 输出补出所有五篇I文档均不含的关键年份、名称或better词值；词义理解是否需要文档另行标记，不据此认定参数记忆。
